summary: Kyivstar Group Ltd. filed Form 6-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held May 12, 2026. Shareholders approved a Bye-law amendment, appointed UHY LLP as auditor for FY2026, and re-elected all ten director nominees including Kaan Terzioglu as Chairman. The filing is a routine disclosure of annual meeting outcomes with no special situation such as a merger, tender, or strategic change. As a foreign private issuer report on Form 6-K, it provides standard corporate governance updates with no deal terms, premiums, or structural changes. What to watch: any subsequent operational or strategic filings.
